Vowel and /l/ articulation by morphological context

Source: R/data.R
fuzzy_contrasts.Rd

Ultrasound tongue imaging of GOOSE + /l/ and FOOT + /l/ in Southern British English, from 20 speakers in two age groups. Each speaker reads 24 words four times. The /l/ is inside a morpheme (hula, bully), at the end of a morpheme before a suffix (fool-ing, pull-ing), at the end of a word before a vowel (fool it) or at the end of a word before a consonant (fool five). ld places each frame on a scale from the clear /l/ and front vowel of hula to the dark /l/ and back vowel of fool five. fool-ing is much further along that scale than hula; pull-ing is only slightly further than bully, and more so for younger speakers. For GAMMs and morphology-phonetics interactions.

Usage

fuzzy_contrasts

Format

A tibble with 21120 rows and 11 columns:

speaker

OF1 to OF7, OM1 to OM3, YF1 to YF7 and YM1 to YM3 (older or younger, female or male).

age_group

"older" (45 to 66) or "younger" (20 to 28).

sex

"female" or "male".

vowel

"GOOSE" or "FOOT".

context

"morpheme_internal", "morpheme_final", "word_prevocalic" or "word_preconsonantal".

word

Test item, three per vowel and context. A hyphen marks a suffix and a hash a word boundary.

repetition

1 to 4.

token

One level per token (speaker.word.repetition).

duration

Duration of the vowel + /l/ sequence in ms.

time

Normalised time over the first half of the vowel + /l/ sequence, 0 to 100 in steps of 10.

ld

Linear discriminant value. Higher values mean a backer vowel and a darker /l/.

Source

data-raw/fuzzy_contrasts.R

Details

True model:

ld = -2 + s0 + w0 + t0 + 0.6 * time / 100 + effect * (1 - 0.25 * time / 100) + e

where effect is 0 for morpheme_internal, 2.6 (GOOSE) or 2 (FOOT) for word_prevocalic and 4 for word_preconsonantal. For morpheme_final it varies by speaker. For GOOSE it is uniform between 1 and 2.2. For FOOT it is 0.7 for four older speakers (OF3, OF5, OF7, OM3) and 0 for the other six; 0.8 for younger speakers, except 0.2 for YF6, 0 for YM1 and -0.6 for YF7. With a Welch t-test of morpheme_internal against morpheme_final on each speaker's token means (p < 0.05), this gives the speaker counts reported in the paper: a GOOSE contrast for all 20 speakers; a FOOT contrast in the expected direction for 11 (4 older, 7 younger), none for 8 and a reversed one for YF7. The contrasts shrink by a quarter over the time window. By-speaker intercepts for each vowel s0 have SD 0.3, by-word intercepts w0 SD 0.1 and by-token intercepts t0 SD 0.3. Residuals e are AR(1) with rho 0.8 and innovation SD 0.2, so their SD is 0.33 (0.2 / sqrt(1 - 0.8^2)). Durations are normal with the means and SDs of each vowel and context in Table 2 of Strycharczuk and Scobbie (2017), at least 80 ms.

The speakers, words, repetitions, durations and the order of the contexts follow Strycharczuk and Scobbie (2017). In the paper, ld came from a separate linear discriminant analysis for each speaker and vowel, trained on principal components of the ultrasound images to separate morpheme_internal from word_preconsonantal. Values are therefore not comparable between the two vowels. The ld values and effect sizes are simulated.

References

Strycharczuk, P. & Scobbie, J. M. (2017). Whence the fuzziness? Morphological effects in interacting sound changes in Southern British English. Laboratory Phonology, 8(1), 7. doi:10.5334/labphon.24

Examples

aggregate(ld ~ vowel + context, data = fuzzy_contrasts, FUN = mean)
#>   vowel             context          ld
#> 1 GOOSE   morpheme_internal -1.56670303
#> 2  FOOT   morpheme_internal -1.76651023
#> 3 GOOSE      morpheme_final -0.29459280
#> 4  FOOT      morpheme_final -1.32580492
#> 5 GOOSE     word_prevocalic  0.60080417
#> 6  FOOT     word_prevocalic -0.06529356
#> 7 GOOSE word_preconsonantal  2.02781364
#> 8  FOOT word_preconsonantal  1.75710871
if (requireNamespace("mgcv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  foot <- droplevels(subset(fuzzy_contrasts, vowel == "FOOT" &
                              context %in% c("morpheme_internal", "morpheme_final")))
  foot$group <- interaction(foot$age_group, foot$context)
  m <- mgcv::bam(ld ~ group + s(time, by = group, k = 5) +
                   s(time, speaker, bs = "fs", m = 1, k = 5),
                 data = foot, discrete = TRUE)
  summary(m)$p.table
}
#>                                  Estimate Std. Error    t value     Pr(>|t|)
#> (Intercept)                    -1.8588059 0.10718164 -17.342578 1.466957e-65
#> groupyounger.morpheme_internal  0.1906198 0.15157879   1.257563 2.086059e-01
#> groupolder.morpheme_final       0.3001819 0.01861126  16.129047 3.705864e-57
#> groupyounger.morpheme_final     0.7713528 0.15157773   5.088827 3.728475e-07
